pictures.author: MohammadHuzam
pictures.observations: Unobstructed full skyline: pale straight shaft, three service collars, blue bulbous upper house/white shoulder and very long segmented thin antenna. Use real colors and overall silhouette; photo is distant, so fine head inventory comes from mapped parts as approximate massing.

pictures.author: Makaay31
pictures.observations: Useful close lower-tower view: panel-clad pale shaft with a dark full-height vertical window strip. Three stacked flared concrete base tiers with blue rounded/pointed glazed panels, white broad mullions and restrained perimeter guards. Adjacent tall Ma'mun Centre is a separate building and remains host context.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Baghdad Tower exterior: mapped205m overall height, panel-clad cylindrical shaft/dark vertical strips, three service collars, three flared base tiers/blue arched closed glazing, broad flared lower crown/blue windowed head, twelve map-derived radial crown sectors and long segmented warning-painted mast. Original shared concrete/panel/paint surfaces and texture-free blue PBR glazing. Keep the separate Ma'mun Centre and neighborhood in the host scene. No furnished restaurant, machinery/interior, copied identity text, image atlas, precinct slab or terrain/water cutout.
